headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic Designer with hands-on experience delivering print and digital brand assets, campaigns, and marketing collateral.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: CorelDRAW, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Figma, Framer, Webflow

skills.label: Design & Production
skills.items: Print production, visual identity, typography, layout, print-ready file management, responsive design

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives spanning branding, recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Developed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Utilized Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.
Conducted usability testing, feeding findings back into user flows and interface usability.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Designed logo, typography, and color palette for internal branding kit.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her current hands-on graphic design experience at Ascent producing 100+ print and digital assets, and highlighted CorelDRAW and print production capabilities to match the target role.
omitted: AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) omitted as they do not appear in the job posting requirements.
Bounceless B2B UX case study omitted to keep the focus strictly on graphic design and visual communication.
